verdict.rationale: GitLab's marketing docs mention AI agents that 'review code while your team stays in control' and orchestrate within the lifecycle, implying an AI reviewer capability exists, but there is no detail on how to assign an AI reviewer to a merge request, no workflow documentation, and no community/hands-on evidence of faster turnaround. Missing for 10: concrete docs on assigning AI as MR reviewer, workflow/UI details, and independent verification of turnaround speed improvements.
